# Discovery Engagement Proposal ## Engagement Overview and Scope We propose a four-week discovery-only engagement to evaluate your current operations and establish a clear path forward. The scope is strictly limited to producing three deliverables: * Current-state process map * Prioritized backlog * Implementation recommendation *Exclusions:* Implementation, integrations, production support, and guaranteed savings are explicitly excluded from this scope. ## Client Responsibilities and Acceptance Successful execution relies on the client supplying: * Interview access * Relevant source documents Acceptance occurs when the client sponsor confirms delivery of the three listed artifacts. ## Commercial Offer The commercial terms for this four-week engagement are as follows: | Metric | Details | | :--- | :--- | | **Effort** | 80 hours | | **Hourly Rate** | $200 / hour | | **Total Investment** | $16,000 | | **Payment Schedule** | 50% at kickoff ($8,000)
50% on delivery ($8,000) | ## Next Steps to Proceed To approve this engagement and begin work, please complete the following: 1. Provide formal signature approving this proposal. 2. Designate a named client contact. Please note that the project start date will be agreed upon only after signature and the provision of your named client contact.

Draft a concise proposal for the client sponsor to approve a discovery engagement. Explain the commercial offer and how the client can proceed.

  "fee": "80 hours at $200/hour. Total $16,000. 50% at kickoff and 50% on delivery.",
  "excluded": "Implementation, integrations, production support and guaranteed savings are excluded.",
  "client": "Client supplies interview access and source documents.",
  "start": "Start date agreed only after signature and named client contact.",
